title: BeFit: Shifting Complexity from Weights to Bernstein Activations for Resource-Constrained Sensing
abstract: arXiv:2611.23520v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time-series sensing increasingly relies on neural networks, yet deployment on resource-constrained microcontrollers remains challenging. Aggressive model compression can reduce accuracy, while restricting weights to multiplication-free representations introduces further losses. We present BeFit, an end-to-end framework that shifts model capacity from weights to learnable Bernstein polynomial activations. BeFit (i) finds compact Bernstein-activated convolutional neural networks (BeCNNs) through hardware-aware neural architecture search and trains them via knowledge distillation; (ii) projects their weights to multiplication-free codes, freezes the codes, and recovers the resulting accuracy loss through the learnable activations; and (iii) generates model-specific kernels that exploit the projected weights for multiplication-free convolutions. translated_title: BeFit：将复杂度从权重转移到Bernstein激活以实现资源受限感知
translated_abstract: 时间序列感知越来越依赖神经网络，然而在资源受限的微控制器上进行部署仍然充满挑战。激进的模型压缩会降低准确率，而将权重限制为无乘法表示则会带来进一步的精度损失。我们提出了BeFit，这是一个将模型容量从权重转移到可学习Bernstein多项式激活函数的端到端框架。BeFit（i）通过硬件感知的神经架构搜索找到紧凑的Bernstein激活卷积神经网络，并通过知识蒸馏进行训练；（ii）将权重投影为无乘法编码并冻结这些编码，同时通过可学习的激活函数恢复由此产生的精度损失；（iii）生成针对特定模型的内核，利用投影后的权重实现无乘法卷积。在人体活动识别任务上，BeCNN平均比……准确2.75个百分点（pp）
tldr: BeFit提出了一种端到端框架，通过将模型容量从权重转移到可学习的Bernstein多项式激活函数，并结合硬件感知架构搜索、知识蒸馏和无乘法内核生成，在资源受限的微控制器上实现了高精度的无乘法卷积神经网络。
en_tdlr: BeFit is an end-to-end framework that shifts model capacity from weights to learnable Bernstein polynomial activations, combining hardware-aware neural architecture search, knowledge distillation, and model-specific multiplication-free kernels to achieve accurate multiplication-free CNNs on resource-constrained microcontrollers.
